authority.note: Newest R40 review-corrected Blender master is intentional authority.

target: Quest 2/3 PC VR through Link or Air Link; not standalone Android

checks.name: eight_standard_views_complete
checks.detail: Front, left, right, rear, roof, entrance, aerial, and 1.7 m player-eye views are complete and mutually consistent.

checks.name: additive_scene_alignment
checks.detail: No visible gaps, offsets, or rotations at zone boundaries in the full additive assembly.

checks.name: floor_band_continuity
checks.detail: Repeated tower floor bands remain level and continuous around the front/right corner.

checks.name: right_wing_rear_closure
checks.detail: Right-wing rear/service enclosure is visibly closed and aligned with podium and tower geometry.

checks.name: loading_area
checks.detail: Loading opening, shutter, canopy, bollards, curb, and adjacent wall read correctly without clipping.

checks.name: roof_and_service_geometry
checks.detail: Roof perimeter, inner plant enclosure, and service volumes are present without obvious open seams.

checks.name: entrance_and_player_scale
checks.detail: Entrance composition, door clearances, signage, canopy, and 1.7 m eye-height scale are coherent.

checks.name: materials_glass_and_interior_shell
checks.detail: Opaque, glass, frame, accent, furniture, and interior-shell layers remain visually distinct with no missing-material fallback.

limitations: This review freezes integration and visual correctness; it does not claim headset GPU performance acceptance.
Quest Link or Air Link stereo CPU/GPU capture on Quest 2 and/or Quest 3 remains required before Stage 6 performance acceptance.
